title: 外倾对角脚点
description: 钢笔淡彩突出浅外倾墙的对角脚点与稳稳保留的两脚。

art_direction.medium: soft pastel drawing with clear contour accents
art_direction.scene: An original ink-and-wash illustration shows a fictional adult balanced across two diagonally arranged low footholds on a shallow overhanging bouldering wall. Both shoes visibly press their positive edges, one knee is naturally bent, and broad orange handholds keep a short next reach controlled. Avoid tangled legs or an exaggerated suspended pose. Use a side-oblique medium-wide camera that includes the entire clothed figure, modest wall angle, and thick continuous crash mat. Delicate blue ink, pale ochre washes, and warm terracotta clothing convey a quiet focused moment. The route remains close to the floor. Include no captions, brands, jumping, cut-loose feet, or dramatic exposure.
